evidence.quote: Duration of the course / programme: 7 semesters
Computer Science Engineering Cloud Service Technologies 2,000 EUR 3,200 EUR IT Security

notes: Tuition: the programme's own page (studyfinder) gives no fee; the university tuition page lists Computer Science Engineering BSc at 3,200 EUR per semester for Non-EEA students under the specialisation 'Cloud Service Technologies / IT Security', used as the institution-wide fee page. The 150 EUR application fee is separate from tuition. The studyfinder page states the programme is available in the Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme, but that is a scholarship, not the self-financed route. No documents list specific to this programme was found in the supplied pages; the deadlines page mentions a School Leaving Certificate upload deadline of 1 August but without stating the eligibility scope for non-EU applicants.

evidence.quote: G.C.E. or any equivalent high school / secondary education (or higher) diploma and English language certificate of level IELTS 5.0 at least.

note.fr: Des frais de dossier de 150 EUR sont exigés pour chaque candidature et ne sont pas remboursables.
note.en: An application fee of 150 EUR is required for every application and is non-refundable.

evidence.quote: 1. Application fee: 150 EUR This fee is required for every application, is paid during the application process, and is non-refundable.

note.fr: Un examen d'entrée est requis : épreuves écrites de mathématiques et de physique/informatique, ainsi qu'un entretien oral en anglais en ligne.
note.en: An entrance examination is required: written mathematics and physics/informatics exams, plus an online English oral interview.
